title: Coordinate functors, bounds and retained local models for projective-line towers
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, a scheme S on which ell is invertible, tower class data c and abelian coefficient-tower presentations DS, DP [det-sp-tower-classes, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Define push by conjugating the recorded proper derived image with the exact derived realization [def-sp-tower-shriek-realization]; define pullTwist by conjugating exact q-pullback, tensor with the shifted Tate line (1)[2], and the inverse realization. Define bounds(K,r,s,a,b) to assert, at every positive level n+1, cohomology in [r,s], intrinsic constructibility and Tor amplitude [a,b] [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. For a finite ring A killed by N, comparisonModel is termwise etale-to-proetale comparison followed by intrinsic constant-ring realization; lineModel(C) is termwise q-etale-pullback tensor the finite Tate line and shift two [lem-sp-etale-pullback-line-flat-model, def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. LocalModel(A,N,T,K,G,r,s,a,b) retains a bounded constructible etale origin of K with those cohomological and Tor intervals, a flat constructible representative C in [a,b], an etale cover trivializing the line, the actual pulled-back-strata assertion, and flatness, support [a-2,b-2], independent K-flatness and a representing isomorphism to G for the intrinsic pro-etale realization of lineModel(C) [def-pc-kflat-complex]. These are exactly the existing six definitions, with unchanged names and bodies, moved to an importable data module.
